subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Formar, com base em palavras primitivas, palavras derivadas com os prefixos e sufixos mais produtivos no português.

components.description_pt: Identificar raiz compartilhada entre palavra conhecida e desconhecida
components.description_en: Identify the root word shared between a known word and an unknown word
components.cc_component_description: Identify the root word shared between a known word and an unknown word

components.description_pt: Formar palavras derivadas adicionando prefixos produtivos a palavras-base em português
components.description_en: Form derived words by adding productive prefixes to base words in Portuguese
components.cc_component_description: Apply knowledge of common prefixes to determine the meaning of new words

components.description_pt: Analisar como afixos e formas de palavras alteram significado e função da palavra-base
components.description_en: Analyze how affixes and word forms alter the meaning and function of a base word
components.cc_component_description: Analyze how affixes and word forms alter the meaning and function of a base word

cc_matches.description: Use a known root word as a clue to the meaning of an unknown word with the same root (e.g., addition, additional).
Identify and correctly use patterns of word changes that indicate different meanings or parts of speech (e.g., conceive, conception, conceivable).
Determine the meaning of the new word formed when a known prefix is added to a known word (e.g., happy/unhappy, tell/retell).
